items:
The perfect getaway for your family's next vacation to the world's most beautiful beaches! Construction finished in March 2022. This is a stunning home in a hidden gem of a new community near Rosemary Beach. You'll be in walking distance to South Walton beaches right across the road (1/2 mile) from the Inlet Beach Access (the BEST Beach Access on 30A!)

First Floor:
You're welcomed by the cool beach hues and cute sitting area. There is a convenient king master suite on this level as well as a stacked washer/dryer by the stairs. The master bathroom is like a true spa experience with large rainfall shower and separate soaking tub.

Second Floor:
The main open concept area. There's a large kitchen with island with seating for 4 and separate dining table for 8. This crisp white kitchen overlooks the entertaining area for maximum family and friends togetherness. Everyone will love the large TV beautifully framed by comfortable furnishings. The balcony has even more spots for rest and relaxation plus the gas grill.

Third Floor:
You'll find 2 more bedrooms plus the landing has a pullout futon and TV. And even more convenient is the 2nd laundry area. Enjoy another outdoor space on the balcony - a great spot to grab some fresh air.

You are conveniently located near everything—the beach, restaurants, shopping, Camp St. Helen State Park, and much more. The area’s largest public beach access, with ample parking, restrooms, and showers, is just a 3-minute drive or a 10-minute walk away. The newly opened underpass for foot traffic beneath Highway 98 allows pedestrians and cyclists to safely cross from the north to the south side without encountering vehicles. This provides a more convenient way to walk to the beach and nearby shops.

Sleeping Arrangements:
1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV, patio access. Private bathroom with dual sinks, large shower and separate soaking tub.
2nd Floor, Living Area: Sofa pulls out to a memory foam queen bed
3rd Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV and balcony access. Shared bathroom with tub/shower combo.
3rd Floor, Bedroom 3: Twin-over-full bunk bed + twin trundle, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.
3rd Floor Loft: Futon pulls out to a full bed.

The Ivy at Inlet Beach:
A pedestrian walkway under Highway 98 is under construction, set for completion in 2023 or early 2024, making beach access easy. The new community pool is now open! Inlet Beach is growing, so expect nearby construction.

Inlet Beach & 30A Area:
Shops and dining at 30Avenue and Rosemary Beach are under a mile away. Enjoy breakfast at The Donut Hole, lunch at Goatfeather’s, and dinner at Shades or Amici’s. Camp St. Helen State Park offers fishing and hiking. Just 10 miles away, Pier Park Mall in Panama City Beach has 125+ stores, restaurants, and an IMAX theater.

Your stay at Boho Beach House comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!

* Sorry, no pets allowed.
* Parking for 2 cars (no garage access). No street parking allowed.
* Please note that there is new construction in the area around this house

An initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

responses.response:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience at the Boho Beach House. We are so glad to hear you found the home clean, comfortable, and overall enjoyable; but we also want to sincerely apologize for the inconveniences you encountered.

We understand how important it is, especially when traveling from out of state, to have accurate information about amenities like garage access, bikes, and beach gear. We are truly sorry for the confusion and for any outdated or misleading photos that may have caused unmet expectations. We are currently reviewing the listing to ensure all information and images accurately reflect the current offerings so future guests have a clearer picture before booking.

We also apologize for the lack of response regarding your request for blankets. That is not the level of service we strive for, and we’re following up internally to ensure our communication improves moving forward.

We appreciate your kind comments about the home itself, and we are grateful you left helpful beach gear with a neighbor. That is a generous gesture. If you choose to return in the future, we would love the opportunity to better meet your expectations and offer a smoother experience.

Regards,
Benchmark Management

Reviewer Comments:
We really enjoyed out stay at the Boho Beach House. It was very clean and comfortable. There were 2 things that would have been nice and I'm not sure if the ownership changed or what happened but in the original photos we saw 4 bikes in the garage some beach accessories but when we arrived, we learned we had no access to the garage, bikes, or anything else. This was essential for us since we flew from Virginia and we would have selected another house had we known that. We ended up having to rent 4 bikes, buy boogie boards and a few chairs (that we left with a neighbor) and this made our trip much more expensive than we planned.Also, there are no blankets in the house. I called and left a message for Benchmark properties requesting a few blankets but I never received a response.In all, the house is lovely and if you drive and bring your own gear, I think you will be very happy renting this home.
